messages.author: 5998661b9f5e4691
messages.subject: coord_trans problem 0.8.5 - y scale
parts:
Hi,

using coord_trans(x="log10"), I get errornous display when using
ggplot2 version 0.8.5. By the way, this does not occur in 0.8.3.

df=data.frame(a=abs(rnorm(26)),letters)
ggplot(df,aes(a,letters)) + geom_point() + coord_trans(x="log10")

Look at the huge white space on top of the letters.

Using the following I get what I expect:
breaks=c(0.5,1,1.5,2,2.5)
ggplot(df,aes(a,letters)) + geom_point()
+scale_x_log10(breaks=breaks,labels=breaks)

Thanks for the wonderful package!

Best,
Florian

I don't know what causes it, but it is a general problem with
coord_trans. You get the same increased vertical extension of the y-
axis with:

ggplot(df,aes(a,letters)) + geom_point() + coord_trans(xtrans="sqrt")

and even

ggplot(df,aes(a,letters)) + geom_point() + coord_trans(xtrans="sqrt",
ytrans="inverse")

--Brian
